items.prompt:
A synthetic material is one that is:
A) Found ready-made in nature
B) Made by people through chemical processes
C) Always alive
D) A kind of rock
items.answer: B) Made by people through chemical processes

steps: Synthetic materials are human-made through chemical processes.

items.prompt:
Synthetic materials ultimately come from:
A) Nothing
B) Natural resources
C) Only the Sun
D) Other planets

steps: Even human-made materials start from natural resources.

items.prompt:
Most plastic is made from which natural resource?
A) Water
B) Petroleum (oil)
C) Gold
D) Sand only

steps: Plastics are made by processing petroleum.

items.prompt:
Which is a positive impact of synthetic materials?
A) They provide useful products and medicines
B) They always cause harm
C) They cannot be used
D) They are invisible
items.answer: A) They provide useful products and medicines

steps: Synthetic materials provide many useful products and medicines.

items.prompt:
Which is a negative impact of synthetic materials?
A) They provide medicines
B) They can create pollution and waste
C) They are useful
D) They come from nature
items.answer: B) They can create pollution and waste

steps: Some synthetic materials cause pollution or persistent waste.

items.prompt:
Why is it accurate to say human-made materials depend on nature?
A) They are made from natural resources taken from Earth
B) They come from nowhere
C) They are alive
D) They need no materials
items.answer: A) They are made from natural resources taken from Earth

steps: Synthetic materials are produced from natural resources.

items.prompt:
A community decides to reduce single-use plastics. The best reason is to:
A) Increase pollution
B) Reduce waste from a synthetic material that is hard to break down
C) Use more petroleum
D) Make plastics stronger
items.answer: B) Reduce waste from a synthetic material that is hard to break down

steps: Reducing plastic use lowers waste and environmental impact.

items.prompt:
Which statement best shows the connection between synthetic materials and society?
A) Synthetic materials have no effects
B) They provide benefits like medicines but can also cause pollution
C) They are only harmful
D) They are only helpful
items.answer: B) They provide benefits like medicines but can also cause pollution

steps: Synthetic materials have both positive and negative impacts on society.
